verdict.rationale: Rive removes the handoff step: the exported .riv file is what ships, rendered by open-source runtimes across web, mobile and game engines and driven from app code through data binding and view models. It does not produce component-to-code mappings or generated framework code, though RML offers a text/XML representation of files. Community posts describe client adoption and smooth engine integration. Missing for 10: component-to-code mapping into the developer's own UI components, editable source-code output (as opposed to a runtime-dependent asset), and independent hands-on evidence of production use.
